rule.form: upgrade the model tier (haiku -> opus) iff  g_hat(k) >= tau
rule.gain_model: g_hat(k) = c * (k+1)^(-d)   [expected reduction in per-item task loss from the upgrade]
rule.threshold: k*(tau) = (c/tau)^(1/d) - 1 ; upgrade iff observed effective_k <= k*
rule.observable: effective_k = min(k, profile_len), known before the model call

validation.protocol: 20 random 50/50 splits of users (qids), seeds 1000-1019; c,d fitted on the train half only; losses evaluated on held-out users; oracle = per-k best arm chosen on held-out truth; random-matched = policy upgrading the same NUMBER of k buckets, chosen uniformly at random (200 draws/split)
